nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' storing the token name, set once in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol' storing the token symbol, set once in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' storing the token decimals, set once in the constructor.
Constant 2**256 - 1 returned as total supply, balance and allowance by every view function.
Constructor that writes _name, _symbol and _decimals into the corresponding state variables.
Public view function returning MAX_UINT unconditionally.
Public view function returning MAX_UINT for any address given, ignoring the argument.
Public function that emits a Transfer event with msg.sender as the sender and always returns true without moving any value.
Public function that emits an Approval event with msg.sender as owner and always returns true without recording any allowance.
Public view function returning MAX_UINT for any owner/spender pair.
Public function that emits a Transfer event for arbitrary _from/_to and always returns true without transferring balances or allowances.
Caller-controlled address used as the event 'from'/'owner' field in transfer and approve.
Constructor parameter holding the token name.
Constructor parameter holding the token symbol.
Constructor parameter holding the token decimals.
Destination address of the transfer call, used only in the emitted event.
Value of the transfer call, used only in the emitted event.
Spender address of the approve call, used only in the emitted event.
Value of the approve call, used only in the emitted event.
Named return variable of balanceOf, always assigned MAX_UINT.
Event Transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value) emitted without any balance check or state change: allows spoofed transfer events for arbitrary amounts from the caller address.
Event Approval(msg.sender, _spender, _value) emitted without recording any allowance: allows spoofed approval events.

approve unconditionally executes the Approval event emission and returns true.
